description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Boulderbranch Golem.
Boulderbranch Golem enters the battlefield, causing you to gain six life.
Cryptic Trilobite triggers, putting six +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
